children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on September 4, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.

Bombay Metrics shares surged 12.20% to ₹40, trading above its 30-day, 50-day and 150-day simple moving averages of ₹35.65, ₹35.88 and ₹38.73, respectively, but remained below its 200-day moving average of ₹41.21.
Infomedia Press gained 7.55% to ₹5.70, moving above its 30-day, 50-day and 150-day moving averages of ₹5.30, ₹5.45 and ₹5.50, while remaining marginally below its 200-day moving average of ₹5.74.

Puravankara rose 7.25% to ₹230.25, trading above all four key moving averages — 30-day at ₹214.69, 50-day at ₹217.34, 150-day at ₹213.58 and 200-day at ₹220.62 — indicating strong near-term price momentum.
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.
Purv Flexipack shares fell 4.94% to ₹45.80, trading below their 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day moving averages of ₹48.18, ₹49.19, ₹58.74 and ₹67.89, respectively.

Mobilise App shares declined 4.16% to ₹108.15, below the 30-day moving average of ₹112.85 but slightly above the 50-day moving average of ₹107.62. The 150-day and 200-day moving averages are not available.
General Insurance Corporation of India shares dropped 3.47% to ₹343.65, trading below all key moving averages — 30-day at ₹355.99, 50-day at ₹358.43, 150-day at ₹373.95 and 200-day at ₹374.73.

Meanwhile, several stocks touched fresh 52-week high, highlighting persistent buying. Notable names touching new high included Lenskart Solutions, Capri Global, RBL Bank, Solar Industries, Welspun Living, Anthem Bio, Redington.
Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri, AKI India, Onix Solar Energy among others were locked in their upper circuits, reflecting strong buying and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

title: Momentum Stocks: Lenskart Solutions, Capri Global, RBL Bank, hit 52-week high
